verdict.description: Overall verdict on the reviewed diff.

findings.description: Real, actionable findings tied to a changed file and line. Empty if the diff is clean.

file.description: Repo-relative path of a file in the reviewed diff.

line.description: 1-based line number in the changed file.

severity.description: critical = bug, security hole or broken rule; warning = should fix; info = minor.

category.description: bug = logic or correctness; rule = breaks a rule in AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or a standards file; security = a security or privacy issue; test = missing or wrong test; simplify = dead code, duplication, needless complexity; style = naming, comments, idiom; plan = differs from the approved plan.

body.description: What is wrong, why it matters, and the concrete fix.
